messages:
olivia: FYI CI started failing on a handful of routing manifests with `unknownField: quotas` even though Console preview shows no errors. Anyone seen this?
kevin: hm, can you paste the route YAML? guessing schema drift between local linter and registry.
olivia: here it is:
```yaml
route: /api/generate
methods: [POST]
model: llm-proxy-v2
quotas:
  monthly: 100000
  per_user: 1000
policies:
  header_transform:
    add:
      X-Org: redwood
```
maya: Aha — we moved `quotas` under `policies` in the schema bump a few weeks ago (`policies.quotas`). Console preview is still tolerant (it renders fine), but the CI uses the strict schema bundle.
raul: Wouldn’t it be better for the linter to suggest an autofix: move `quotas` under `policies` and add a warning? few teams hit this repeatedly.
schema-bot: schema-lint: error: unknownField "quotas" at /route. Suggestions: (1) migrate to `policies.quotas` (2) set `schemaVersion: 2024-11` to opt-in to new validation.
kevin: I like autofix + hint. We need a couple of safety checks though — if there's already `policies` with another `quotas` entry, avoid clobbering. Also preserve comments where possible.
maya: Agreed. Proposed behavior: in Console editor, show a non-blocking banner: "Detected legacy `quotas`. Click to migrate to `policies.quotas` (preview changes)." If user accepts, we run a best-effort transform. In CI, currently it's strict and fails. Maybe CI should emit a more actionable error linking to the autofix docs.
olivia: For local repro: `make validate-manifests` -> output below:
```
$ make validate-manifests
> schema-lint /manifests/routes/api-generate.yaml
error: unknownField \"quotas\" at /route
```
raul: Small compatibility option: allow a `legacyQuotas: true` toggle in repo-level config so infra teams can opt-out of strictness while they gradually migrate. But long-term we should encourage migration.
kevin: Tests — we should add a unit test that loads old-style route and ensures linter suggests migration instead of crashing. Example pseudo-test:
```go
func TestQuotaMigrationSuggestion(t *testing.T) {
  r := loadYAML("old_quota.yaml")
  res := LintRoute(r)
  require.Contains(t, res.Suggestions, "move to policies.quotas")
}
```
maya: I'll prototype the Console banner + autofix patch. Two parts: (1) update client-side linting to detect legacy keys and present preview diff, (2) server-side linter returns structured suggestion metadata so Console can render a one-click transform.
schema-bot: issue created: #4321 — "lint: handle legacy quotas with autofix & console hint" (assigned to maya).
console-bot: deploy-preview: staging console with lint-suggestion UI is available at https://staging.console.redwood/preview/4321 (:eyes:)
olivia: Nice — i'll test with our repo and report any comment preservation issues. Thanks! :raised_hands:
